ideas.pitch: A reinforcement learning policy wrapper that dynamically adjusts decision-making parameters of ML models during live arena tournaments.
ideas.problem_statement: Model Wars: Build, train, and optimize machine learning models to face off against each other in a Rocket League-style tournament.
ideas.title: ArenaTactician: RL Policy Optimizer for Head-to-Head Model Battles
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-performance feature engineering with strategic gameplay adaptation, directly addressing the unique arena-battle judging criteria.

ideas.pitch: An automated feature extraction and selection pipeline designed specifically to process high-frequency match telemetry under strict time constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: Model Wars: Teams will work through data analysis, feature engineering, model development, hyperparameter tuning, and optimization under strict time and computational constraints.
ideas.title: DataForge: Rapid Feature Engineering Pipeline for Arena Combat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the data engineering pillar of the competition, ensuring the submitted model trains faster and handles edge-case arena states better than raw models.

ideas.pitch: A meta-learning voting classifier that combines distinct gradient boosted trees, neural networks, and decision trees into a single cohesive arena combat agent.
ideas.problem_statement: Model Wars: Form teams and build your own ML model to face off against each other in an arena-based battle.
ideas.title: EnsembleArena: Multi-Model Voting System for Competitive Domination
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages ensemble robustness to outperform single-algorithm models in unpredictable head-to-head tournament scenarios.

ideas.pitch: A real-time dashboard tracking model decision latencies, feature importance shifts, and live win-rate metrics during tournament face-offs.
ideas.problem_statement: Model Wars: With a dynamic competitive environment, live results, and a unique blend of Machine Learning + competitive gaming.
ideas.title: ModelScope: Live Telemetry and Performance Debugger for ML Arenas
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides judges with immediate visual clarity on why a specific model is winning or losing in the arena, creating an unforgettable presentation hook.

ideas.pitch: An aggressive hyperparameter optimization utility built to maximize model inference speed and predictive accuracy under strict competition compute limits.
ideas.problem_statement: Model Wars: Complete development within the given time and computational limits. Submit your final model.
ideas.title: HyperArena: Automated Hyperparameter Tuning for Low-Latency Bot Action
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the computational constraint requirement, ensuring maximum throughput and faster reaction times during live arena matches.
